description: Create a new Angular application with a clean project structure and a working starter page.
requirements: Repository should contain a valid Angular project created with Angular CLI or an equivalent Angular setup
Project should include package.json, angular.json and src application files
Application should run locally using an npm script such as npm start or ng serve
Starter page should include at least one custom component beyond the default app shell
README.md should include setup, install and run instructions
Repository should include a successful build command such as npm run build or ng build
title: Create Angular Project
